To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) text-based image retrieval with query expansion is a promising approach to large-scale cross-media retrieval, (2) the performance can be further improved by combining the results from multiple retrieval approaches, and (3) Wikipedia is a valuable knowledge base for cross-media retrieval.

(i) text-based retrieval is more robust and effective than content-based retrieval, (ii) query expansion with terms selected from a knowledge-base is more effective than query expansion with terms automatically selected, (iii) query expansion with textual terms is more effective than visual query expansion, and (iv) combining text and visual retrieval is more effective than using either of the two alone.

(1) query expansion can improve image retrieval performance; (2) visual concept detection can improve image retrieval effectiveness; (3) cross-media retrieval can further improve image retrieval performance.
